assertion_boundaries: The June-20 ledger covers 858 registered batch records: 841 unverified inputs, 16 served-byte matches and one retained-byte match. Current manifestations have separate witnesses. These counts are not a whole-registry hash audit.

The entity index labels total_terms 7,173 while its concepts array has 7,176. Lexical descriptions retain older totals while the current terms array has 12,871. Prefer the stated extraction unit, array count and fetched hash.

The live v12.167 data report 633 addresses and 813 observations; the deposited #1676 title says 811 captures. Preserve this discrepancy until reconciled. Nested observations alone omit an entry’s first observation.

The expanded MPAI page points to #987, whose current body is a Forward Library planning document. This packet cites the expanded page for its template, #656 for the precursor, #711 for relational verification and #726 for LFB. It does not silently substitute #987.

Identify declares persistent deleted records and oai_dc is advertised. The observed GetRecord #558 exports URL and AXN, but not its separately available SWHID or former DOIs. This is a specific export-field gap, not absence of the richer registry data.
Current Oracle mode text and older Book auto-append text describe different retention behavior. The historical index holds 207 entries. Mode-sensitive reading is necessary.
The journal manifest is an August export, not a current total of all holdings. The Surface Weather Station carries a five-reading June baseline. Do not present either as an October benchmark.

The directory introduction says read v1.1, while its manifest also registers a v1.2 addendum and uses dataset-manifest version v2.0. These are different artifact/version units. Do not promote a historical implementation map to a current protocol without checking the operative data.

Declared text-status fields, published guarantees, source shelf counts and instrument interfaces were inspected. Not every artifact, full protocol workflow, task or peer comparator was exercised. No external-model test battery or Assembly review was run for this draft.
The observed /continuity/ navigation target returned HTTP 404 in this session. A single route finding is a repairable access defect; it does not determine the performance of unrelated functions.
